# Waterbom Bali Tickets

> Official online reseller of Waterbom Bali tickets, operated by DubaiTicketDeals.com. Waterbom Bali is Asia's #1 water park, located on Jl. Kartika Plaza in Kuta, Bali. Open 9AM–6PM daily. Book secure e-tickets online with instant QR vouchers and promo-code discounts.

## Key facts
- Location: Jl. Kartika Plaza, Kuta, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia (10 min from Ngurah Rai/DPS airport)
- Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM every day; closed only on Nyepi
- Rating: 4.8/5 across 25,000+ reviews; ranked #1 water park in Asia
- Attractions: 22+ slides incl. The Climax, The Constrictor, Smashdown 2.0, Python, Twin Racers, Lazy River, FlowRider, and a kids zone
- Cashless: tap-to-pay Splash Band for all in-park purchases
- Payment: 256-bit SSL, 3D-Secure (Visa, Mastercard, Amex); instant QR e-voucher

## Ticket prices (2026, AED)
- Single Day Pass — International: Adult 128.57, Child 101 | Resident: Adult 75.51, Child 66.33
- Family Day Pass (2 adults + 2 children) — International 449 | Resident 265.31
- Waterbom + Mason Elephant Park combo — International: Adult 183.67, Child 136.73
- Children are ages 2–11; infants under 2 free. Resident rate requires valid ID.

## Promo codes (2026)
- SPLASH20 — 20% off entire order (best deal)
- NOCAP15 — 15% off, no minimum
- FIRSTDIP — 10% off first visit
- Apply at secure checkout; one code per order.
